lines.text: This punch will never touch you.
If you had Gojo's Infinity, the space between you and the fist never runs out.
To reach your face, it first crosses half the distance. Then half of what's left. Then half again.
Punches, bullets, even trucks slow down forever.
But calculating that every second would fry a normal brain.
That's why Gojo needs the Six Eyes, to control it perfectly.
Push the Infinity inward, and you get Blue. It pulls everything toward you.
Reverse it, and you get Red. It blasts everything away.
Crash them together, and Hollow Purple erases whatever it touches.
And inside Unlimited Void, your enemy gets infinite information, and can't move.
But there's a way around it.
Toji's Inverted Spear cancels the technique on contact.
And Sukuna stopped aiming at Gojo. He cut the space itself.
So the punch never lands… unless someone cuts the world in half.
